name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and manages Nginx as a multi-site static web server with HTTPS virtual hosts, development certificates, security headers, rate limiting, Fail2ban, firewall configuration, SSH hardening, and kernel network hardening.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis, including Redis authentication, log directory management, and a post-configuration workaround for replication-related settings.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys a FastAPI tutorial application with Python, a virtual environment, PostgreSQL database and user setup, environment configuration, and a systemd-managed Uvicorn service.
